Container.Name: Kometa Asset Manager
Container.Overview: KAM (Kometa Asset Manager) manages the artwork in your Kometa asset folders. It connects to Plex, shows every movie, show and collection next to the artwork Kometa will use, and lets you upload, import from Plex, send to Plex, and clean up orphaned or duplicate asset folders. Files are saved with the names and layout Kometa expects. Kometa must be set up to create asset folders first (assets_for_all and create_asset_folders).

Config.Name: Web Port
Config.Description: Container 8000 -> Host port for the web UI

Config.Name: Assets Root
Config.Description: Root folder that contains Movies/TV/Collections subfolders

Config.Name: Config Folder
Config.Description: Where KAM keeps its settings, folder assignments and exclusions

Config.Name: Plex Verify SSL
Config.Description: Set to false only if Plex uses a self-signed HTTPS certificate.

Config.Name: Auth Mode
Config.Description: Optional. Leave blank to use the Settings page, or set builtin or reverse_proxy.

Config.Name: Auth Username
Config.Description: Optional. Leave blank to use the Settings page.

Config.Name: Auth Password
Config.Description: Optional. Setting a password turns on the built-in login. Leave blank to use the Settings page.

Config.Name: Secure Auth Cookie
Config.Description: auto detects HTTPS; true forces an HTTPS-only cookie; false allows plain HTTP.

Config.Name: CORS Origins
Config.Description: Optional comma-separated origins allowed to call the API from another website. Leave blank to keep it off.
